justification: Evidence page (planner-facing) now shows what the engine already computes: the crossings-only second walk line and its next-to-a-busy-road note, why the walk is a range (the margins), a count line over the 13 exclusion rows, a 'to check by hand' list built from the rows the tool did not clear, notes moved above the walk, a scope sentence under the council controls, the law date on the exclusions heading, and a footer saying the page is not a planning certificate and the planner or council decides. No query, no schema, no new regulatory figure: pure reshaping in services/evidence_statement.py plus page text. Every new field is optional on the page so an older server answer still renders.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_evidence_statement.py -q -o addopts= ; cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/components/evidence-statement-page.test.tsx
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Three hand mutations each turned a Python test red, then were restored: walk() returning None for the crossings-only keys (3 tests fail), removing the margin fallback (test_margins_are_kept_when_the_answer_is_no_because_the_walk_is_too_long fails), and counting an unrecognised result as clear (test_summary_counts_add_up_and_the_line_names_each_result fails). Restored: 26 passed. Jest: 5 passed. tsc --noEmit: 0 errors. react-doctor on the 3 changed files: no issues.
falsifiable_check.fails_when: walk() stops carrying the crossings-only fields or margins, the count line stops adding up to the row count, or the page prints a new part for an older answer that lacks it.

pre_impl.existing_data: services/evidence_statement.build already returned exclusions, walk, notes, council controls and files; lmr_area_decision._crossings_only already puts crossings_only_walk_m and crossings_only_note on the area-check result (live, checked 2026-11-20).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The answer 'no' keeps only five figures in lmr.figures, so margins and walk_best_m are not there; walk() falls back to the same key on the result itself. When an exclusion decides the answer no walk is measured and none is shown.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Only evidence_statement.py shaping and the page text change. The area check, the council controls query and the files query are untouched.
pre_impl.external_source_error: None added: no new source, no network call. The existing 502 path in the proxy is unchanged.
pre_impl.frontend_type: summary, manual_checks and the new walk fields are optional in lib/evidence-statement.ts and isEvidence does not require them, because the page (Vercel) and the data (Railway) deploy separately.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A planner reading an older cached answer sees the page as before, with no empty headings. A planner reading a new answer for an excluded lot sees no walk line and the existing 'No walking range was measured' text, not a made-up one.

functions.name: walk
functions.input: the area-check result dict as returned by decide (may be empty)
functions.output: walk block: range, margins, crossings-only walk and note
functions.if_none: Every missing part stays None; the crossings-only walk is never filled from the normal walk.

functions.name: summary
functions.input: the list of exclusion rows built by exclusions()
functions.output: counts by result and the one-line summary
functions.if_none: No rows give total 0 and an empty line; an unrecognised result is counted as unknown so the counts always add up.

functions.name: manual_checks
functions.input: the list of exclusion rows built by exclusions()
functions.output: the rows with result unknown, warn or not_checked
functions.if_none: No such rows give an empty list and the page prints no heading.

functions.name: EvidenceStatement
functions.input: lat and lng from the address bar
functions.output: the printable page with every new part shown only when present
functions.if_none: Each new part is rendered only when its data is present.

values.guard_at: frontend-nextjs/app/reports/evidence-statement/EvidenceStatement.tsx (printed only when the note is present)
frontend-nextjs/app/reports/evidence-statement/EvidenceStatement.tsx (printed only when both margins are present)
values.if_missing: The range reason sentence is left out.

break_it.scenario: The data server is older than the page and sends no summary, manual_checks or new walk fields.
break_it.what_happens: The page renders as before; none of the new headings or sentences appear.
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated: every new field is optional in the types and isEvidence does not require it.
break_it.how: The first Jest test asserts the new parts are absent for an old-shape payload.

break_it.scenario: An exclusion decides the answer, so no walk was measured.
break_it.what_happens: walk_low_m and crossings_only_walk_m stay None; the page says no walking range was measured and shows no crossings-only line.

break_it.scenario: The area check adds a new result word the summary does not know.
break_it.what_happens: It is counted as 'could not be determined', never as clear, and the counts still add up.
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated: unrecognised results map to unknown.
break_it.how: test_summary_counts_add_up_and_the_line_names_each_result fails when the mapping is changed to clear.

post_merge.manual_verify: Open /reports/evidence-statement?lat=-33.735496841364196&lng=151.13852529738543 (28 Selwyn Street, Pymble) once the Python API and the front end have both deployed: the crossings-only line, the count line, the by-hand list and the footer should show. Until the API deploys, the page renders without the new parts.
